svg.title: Move a chapter, and everything renumbers
svg.desc: A before-and-after example. Before: main.tex lists \include{chapters/01-intro}, \include{chapters/02-methods}, then \include{chapters/03-results}. The PDF's contents list 1. Intro, 2. Methods on page 5, and 3. Results on page 12, and the Results chapter page shows the heading 3. Results, the text see Figure 3.1, and a figure captioned Figure 3.1. After: the two include lines are swapped, so results comes before methods. After one compile, every number has changed with a check mark beside it: the contents list 2. Results on page 5 and 3. Methods on page 14, and the chapter page shows 2. Results, see Figure 2.1, and Figure 2.1. The note says: you moved two lines; LaTeX renumbered everything else.
